title: ALWAYS check your orders.
text:
I got the Diana Ross one which was great, thats fun music I didn't have at a very good price.

the next month I checked my orders and saw that it was a compilation of Christian songs. Def don't want that. Had to cancel it. the new one was another Leonard Cohen greatest hits and... I just don't have the energy to cancel because they're not delivering stuff I want.
label: neutral
